title: FantacalcioValidationManifest
description: Result of ONE validation run at ONE level (Batch 0E, design-only). NO parser/ingestion, NO real data, data_promoted stays OFF. Describes the outcome of validating a raw file / acquisition manifest / (future) normalized / vote-record / identity step. NEVER carries secrets, real URLs, tokens, or real Drive ids.

validation_id.description: Stable id for this validation run.

validation_level.description: Which of the 6 validation levels this run covers.

target_ref.description: Reference to what was validated (e.g. acquisition_id, raw_hash, identity_candidate_id). No secrets.

season.description: Canonical season; null when not applicable.

season_code.description: Server code 10..21; null when not applicable.

checks.description: Individual checks performed in this run.

blocking.description: True when this run's status blocks promotion (invalid/requires_manual_review/rejected).

review_item_ref.description: review_item_id when this run opened a manual-review item; null otherwise.

validator.description: Symbolic validator/version (e.g. 'design-v1'). Not a real tool secret.

data_promoted_eligible.description: Always false in Batch 0E: the promotion gate stays OFF.
